An ongoing interest in machine-checked mathematics. I have contributed to
[mathlib](https://leanprover-community.github.io/), the Lean theorem prover's mathematics library:

- Lean's surreal numbers library
- Lean's convex optimization library

I have also taught Lean as a [week-long class at Mathcamp](lean-mc2020.qmd).
